kids: Meet Santa at his North Pole
site: Black River Landing, 421 Black River Lane
about: Santa's North Pole is one of the attractions of Lorain Winterfest, a one day celebration held across downtown Lorain.
The North Pole sits at Black River Landing, a waterfront spot on Black River Lane.
Children who stop by share their holiday wishes with Santa Claus himself.
Every child receives a small gift from Santa's workshop, which the festival calls one of its most beloved traditions.
Visiting hours run from 5 to 9 PM on Saturday, November 28, and the festival points families to Black River Landing right after the parade.
Admission is free for the whole family, with no tickets needed.
The festival advises arriving early, because the line grows as the evening goes on.
The North Pole is outdoors, so the festival tells families to bundle up for a cozy winter evening.
Black River Landing also hosts live reindeer at 5 PM and the International Trees and Trains display from 1 to 9 PM.
The trees represent the diverse international heritage of Lorain, and a classic model train exhibit sits alongside them.
Winterfest organizers can be reached by phone at 440-665-5066 with questions about the evening.
Early in the afternoon, families can start at Veterans Park, where live music and food vendors fill the main stage area before the evening events begin.
Photographers will like the setting, since the festival calls the riverfront a picture perfect backdrop for holiday photos before or after the Santa visit.
Because the North Pole is one of the most popular stops, the festival suggests bringing the whole family and planning the visit before the evening gets busy.
faq: When can kids visit Santa at Lorain Winterfest?
Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 5 to 9 PM.
Where is Santa's North Pole?
At Black River Landing, 421 Black River Lane, Lorain, OH 44052.
Does it cost anything?
No. Admission is free and open to all.
Do kids get a gift?
Yes. Every child receives a small gift from Santa.
Is it indoors?
No. It is an outdoor experience, so dress warmly.
Are photos allowed?
Yes. Photos are welcome.
What else is at Black River Landing?
Live reindeer at 5 PM and the International Trees and Trains display.

about: The holiday parade opens Lorain Winterfest, the one day downtown celebration on Saturday, November 28.
The route runs along Broadway Avenue in Lorain.
Floats, marching bands and community groups fill the route, and Santa Claus rides at the end.
The festival schedule lists the parade from 4:30 to 5 PM.
Organizers suggest lining up early for a great viewing spot along the route.
Free parking is available throughout downtown Lorain, and the parking garage is closed.
After the parade, Santa visits Black River Landing from 5 to 9 PM.
The Veterans Park lighting ceremony is followed by fireworks at 6 PM.
All events at the festival are free and open to the public, except the cash only Secret Santa Shop at the LCCC City Center.
That Secret Santa Shop is part of the LCCC City Center activities on North Abbe Road in Elyria, which also include a magic show, arts and crafts and face painting from 5 to 8 PM.
Guests at the LCCC City Center can also sign Christmas cards for military members and veterans.
Winterfest is a single day event, so the parade and every other attraction happen on that one Saturday.
The route is described as winding down Broadway with illuminated floats.
Spectators are reminded that late November in Lorain can be cold, so layers, hats and gloves for the whole family are a good idea.
The Light Up Lorain ceremony at Veterans Park lights the park and kicks off the evening portion of the celebration.
faq: When is the Lorain Winterfest parade?
Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 4:30 to 5 PM.
Where is the parade route?
Along Broadway Avenue in downtown Lorain, OH 44052.
Is the parade free?
Yes. Parades are free to watch.
Will Santa be in the parade?
Yes. Santa Claus joins the parade.
Where do we park?
Free parking is available throughout downtown. The parking garage is closed.
What happens after the parade?
Families can visit Santa at Black River Landing, then watch fireworks at Veterans Park at 6 PM.
Should we arrive early?
Yes. Organizers advise lining up early for a good spot.
